articles.title: Picolé de costelinha, pastel de frango com quiabo, 'uaikisoba': festival usa a criatividade na comida mineira em Pouso Alegre | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento une gastronomia e shows musicais. Sebrae tem programação de cozinhas-show com receitas feitas por chefs da região.
articles.summary: Evento une gastronomia e shows musicais. Sebrae tem programação de cozinhas-show com receitas feitas por chefs da região.
articles.body:
A comida mineira é a estrela do Festival Gastronômico e Cultural que ocorre em Pouso Alegre (MG) até domingo (13).

Na programação, diversos pratos de diversas origens, mas todos adaptados para o "gostinho mineiro" com muita criatividade, como o picolé de costelinha, o pastel de frango com quiabo e ainda o "uaikisoba" de frango.

Há ainda outras opções como: joelho de porco defumado; tarteletes, bolos e brigadeiros; pastéis de carne, queijo; tropeiro, torresmo e batata chips; poke de salmão; hambúrgueres; saladas, verrines, café especial, sucos naturais e geleias; bolinhos; pão de queijo com geleias; além de Trio da Toca e arroz de costela.

Festival gastronômico em Pouso Alegre tem picolé de costelinha entre as opções — Foto: Sebrae Minas/Divulgação

Os participantes do Festival são empreendedores que passaram por uma consultoria voltada à elaboração de pratos para festivais gastronômicos, realizada pelo Sebrae Minas em parceria com o Sindicato de Hotéis, Restaurantes, Bares e Similares (SINDIPA).

Durante todo o evento, haverá apresentações de talentos locais:

🎤Sábado (12/9) 13h - Yasmin Siebra 15h - Banda Nohau 18h - Rustyca 20h - Trio Scuba 🎶 Domingo (13/09) 13h - Bia 15h - Lê Guimarães 18h - Samba Brazucas

Pastel de frango com quiabo é uma das opções do Festival Gastronômico de Pouso Alegre — Foto: Sebrae/Divulgação

Entre as atrações do festival, haverá apresentações de cozinha-show com chefs da região, que vão preparar receitas e compartilhar técnicas e experiências com o público.

👩‍🍳👨‍🍳 Veja a programação da cozinha-show:

Sábado (12/9) 🌾🌾 14h - Arroz caldoso da Serra da Mantiqueira com a chef Josélia Lemes 🌾🍷 16h - Risoto camponesa com vinho Alma Mineira com a chef Sônia Kohen 🐖☕ 17h30 - Tortelete de ragu de costelinha e barbecue de café especial com os chefs Ricardo Martin e Sônia Lauria

Domingo (13/9) 🧀🍯 14h - Risoto de queijo com mel com a chef Lilian Freitas 🍸🍹16h - Drinks clássicos e contemporâneos com cachaça com chef Léo Gomes 🥔🧀 18h - Nhoque de mandioquinha na fonduta de parmesão com a chef Caroline Bitencourt

Festival Gastronômico e Cultural de Pouso Alegre 🗓️ Até 13 de setembro (domingo) 🕐 A partir das 12h 📍 Via Gastronômica de Pouso Alegre 🎟️ Entrada gratuita

articles.title: Sarau Cultural Iurupari em Santarém: Ufopa tem evento gratuito | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento acontece neste sábado (12) na Unidade Rondon e terá 13 apresentações artísticas; entrada é franca.
articles.summary: O Sarau Cultural Iurupari oferece 13 apresentações gratuitas de música, dança e teatro na Unidade Rondon da Ufopa, em Santarém, neste sábado (12).
articles.body:
Elenco do grupo Teatro Iurupari em cena durante o espetáculo "O Mocó", no encerramento do IV Festival Solos do Pará — Foto: Divulgação

A Universidade Federal do Oeste do Pará (Ufopa), em Santarém , recebe neste sábado (12) a 5ª edição do Sarau Cultural Iurupari. O evento gratuito reúne apresentações de música, dança, teatro e artes plásticas na área externa do Espaço de Formação Cultural, a partir das 19h.

Organizado pelo Teatro Iurupari e pelo Instituto de Ciências da Educação (Iced), em parceria com a Pró-Reitoria de Cultura, Comunidade e Extensão (Procce), o sarau busca incentivar e valorizar a produção artística local.

Para esta edição, foram selecionadas 13 atrações de diferentes segmentos. O público poderá acompanhar:

3 exposições de artes plásticas e visuais;

1 performance que mistura dança, voz e instrumentos.

Onde: Área externa do Espaço de Formação Cultural da Ufopa (Unidade Rondon – Av. Marechal Rondon, s/n, bairro Caranazal)

VÍDEOS: mais vistos do g1 Santarém e Região

articles.title: Lady Gaga and fiancé Michael Polansky welcome their first child together: report
articles.summary: Lady Gaga and fiancé Michael Polansky have reportedly welcomed their first child together, fulfilling the singer's long-expressed desire for motherhood.
articles.body: Lady Gaga is now a mother, according to multiple reports. People and Page Six confirmed that the 40-year-old singer and her fiancé, Michael Polansky, have welcomed their first child together. No other details have been shared. Fox News Digital has reached out to Lady Gaga for comment. The Grammy Award-winning singer spoke to the New York Times in March 2025 about her desire to be a mother, saying she is "excited to be a mom" although she "used to have a lot of apprehension about it." AUBREY PLAZA CONFIRMS PREGNANCY WITH FIRST CHILD AFTER PERSONAL CHALLENGES AND HEALTH STRUGGLES "I’m also kind of at war with myself sometimes as I get ready to, hopefully, become a mom soon," she said. "Like, today is wonderful, but the whole day has revolved around me. There’s an incredible amount of narcissism in this. How do I live a life where I’m passionate about my art while also making more space for other things?" One of her main concerns about motherhood, she shared, was "to not force my children to live a life that they are not choosing," and to "give them space to discover who they are on their own." She also previously spoke about her excitement about having children during a March 2020 interview with InStyle. "Isn’t it incredible what we can do? We can hold a human inside and grow it," she said. "Then it comes out, and it’s our job to keep it alive." The singer hard-launched their relationship by going Instagram official in February 2020, posting a yacht photo sitting in Polansky's lap, captioning the post, "We had so much fun in Miami." The singer confirmed the two were engaged in July 2024, sharing that Polansky had proposed earlier that year, in April. They later made their red carpet debut at the "Joker: Folie à Deux" premiere at the Venice Film Festival in September 2024. "The missing piece in my life was having real love," she told Vogue in September 2024. articles.title: Sonu Nigam sells 3,082 sq ft commercial property in Mumbai’s BKC for Rs 18 crore, earns Rs 3.70 crore profit nearly three years after buying it for Rs 14.30 crore
articles.summary: Singer Sonu Nigam has sold a commercial property in Mumbai’s Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC) for Rs 18 crore, according to property registration documents .
articles.body: Singer Sonu Nigam has sold a commercial property in Mumbai’s Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC) for Rs 18 crore, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix. The singer sold the 3,082 sq ft commercial space nearly three years after purchasing it for Rs 14.30 crore in November 2023.The latest Sonu Nigam property sale adds to the growing list of high-value commercial real estate transactions in Mumbai’s BKC, one of the city’s most sought-after business and financial districts.According to the property registration documents, Sonu Nigam sold the commercial space on September 4, 2026. SAA Estate LLP has been listed as the purchaser, while Sonu Nigam is mentioned as the seller in the registered transaction.The property is located on the ground floor of Trade Centre, opposite the MTNL Building in BKC, Bandra East, Mumbai. The commercial unit has a carpet area of 3,082 sq ft and was sold for a consideration of Rs 18 crore.The transaction also involved a stamp duty payment of Rs 1.08 crore. Two car parking spaces were included as part of the deal, according to the documents.Sonu Nigam earns around Rs 3.70 crore on BKC propertySonu Nigam had purchased the same commercial property for Rs 14.30 crore in November 2023. With the latest sale registered at Rs 18 crore, the singer has made a gross gain of approximately Rs 3.70 crore on the property before accounting for transaction-related costs, taxes and other expenses.Based on the recorded carpet area and the consideration value, the latest transaction works out to approximately Rs 58,404 per sq ft.Kailash Kher also sold BKC office spaceInterestingly, Sonu Nigam is not the only Bollywood or music personality to have recently sold commercial real estate in the same building. Singer Kailash Kher also sold his office space in the building on September 9, 2026, for Rs 10.50 crore.Kher had purchased the property for Rs 10.50 crore in November 2025. Unlike Sonu Nigam’s transaction, the Kailash Kher deal was reportedly executed at the same consideration value at which he had acquired the office space.Sonu Nigam bought an office in Andheri WestInterestingly, Sonu Nigam had also made another commercial real estate investment in Mumbai just a month before the BKC transaction. In August 2026, the Bollywood singer purchased a 258.33 sq ft office space in Mumbai’s Andheri West for Rs 1 crore, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix.The transaction was registered on August 6, 2026, with Singular Health Private Limited listed as the seller and Sonu Agamkumar Nigam, the singer’s full name, recorded as the purchaser.The office unit is located in Sundervan Complex on Lokhandwala Road, Andheri West, and has a carpet area of 258.33 sq ft. Nigam paid a total consideration of Rs 1 crore for the commercial property.In addition to the purchase price, the transaction attracted Rs 6 lakh in stamp duty and a registration fee of Rs 30,000. The total disclosed transaction cost, including stamp duty and registration, stood at Rs 1.063 crore.Based on the consideration value, the Andheri West office deal works out to approximately Rs 38,710 per sq ft of carpet area.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: El otoño que se espera en España... y en el Mediterráneo: ojo a lo que ocurrirá en septiembre, octubre y noviembre
articles.standfirst: Será “probablemente cálido y con mayor potencial de episodios lluviosos”, indica Mario Picazo
articles.summary: Será “probablemente cálido y con mayor potencial de episodios lluviosos”, indica Mario Picazo
articles.body: El verano se va acabando, va dejando rescoldos y el otoño está al acecho. Pero durante los últimos años en España este momento suele aletargarse en el tiempo y asistimos a temperaturas más suaves e incluso calurosas que antaño. Es por ello que Mario Picazo, expertos en el tiempo, ha explicado lo que se está formando con vistas al futuro a corto plazo: “A día de hoy, el Niño se está fortaleciendo en el Pacífico y el escenario merece especial atención”, ha señalado. Los modelos señalan que este fenómeno no solo ha aumentado en exceso las temperaturas durante el verano, sino que además traerá importantes cambios en otoño e invierno. “A día de hoy, el escenario más probable para el otoño es claramente cálido, con un Mediterráneo y Atlántico proporcionando mucha humedad y energía”, apunta. El experto meteorólogo también da detalles de lo que se avecina en una zona en la que hay que mantener la luz de alarma ante lo que puede venir por sorpresa con temporales o DANAs. "El mayor riesgo de episodios de precipitación intensa en el Mediterráneo y Baleares, mientras aumenta progresivamente la posibilidad de entradas atlánticas por el oeste y noroeste”. A todo ello, el cambio de estación oficial llegará el 23 de septiembre y los modelos prevén temperaturas más altas que otros años para los meses de septiembre, octubre y noviembre. Por tanto, Picazo advierte del doble sentido del mismo, ya que la previsión para el otoño de 2026 parece clara. Será “probablemente cálido y con mayor potencial de episodios lluviosos”, indica.

articles.title: Norris takes Madrid pole with 'gorgeous' lap
articles.summary: Lando Norris takes a superb pole position for McLaren at the Spanish Grand Prix, beating Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
articles.body:
Lando Norris took a superb pole position for McLaren at the Spanish Grand Prix, beating Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and Red Bull's Max Verstappen in a breathless final few seconds of qualifying.

"Oh, what a lap, gorgeous," said an ecstatic Norris after pipping world championship leader Antonelli by just 0.011 seconds. "Oh, that might be my best one."

Verstappen was 0.140secs off the pace, as all three moved ahead of Lewis Hamilton's Ferrari in Madrid.

The seven-time champion had held the top spot after the first runs in the final session.

Hamilton's team-mate Charles Leclerc was fifth, ahead of Mercedes' George Russell and the second McLaren of Oscar Piastri.

Norris' pole came from nowhere. He had been fifth in the first session of qualifying, seventh in the second, and 0.449secs slower than Hamilton's pace-setting lap after the first runs in the final session.

"I'm shocked," the world champion said. "I'm a little bit surprised to be here. It was probably one of the best laps I've done ever in my career.

"One of those laps when everything came together. I had a good idea of what I wanted to do, it was whether it came together but my brain let me do it almost perfect. It's one of those laps when you look at the time and go: 'Oh, that was pretty good."

The session had started with predictions of a crash-fest, after drivers had been warning about the high-risk nature of the new Madring street circuit, with tricky entries to corners and walls coming back at the drivers on the exits.

Two red flags during final practice had led some teams to have private sweepstakes as to how many stoppages there would be in qualifying, but the session ran cleanly, with no incidents.

Pole looked to be a battle between Antonelli and the Ferraris, with Verstappen perhaps in the mix.

In the end, the Ferraris faded, as they so often have this year when it really matters, and Norris rose to the front with a breathtaking performance.

"The adrenaline was high on the last lap," he said. "You have to relax and let it all flow.

"It's easy to get tense around here. There's a lot of walls that come at you pretty quickly. I have been feeling pretty good, I just wasn't relaxed.

"I was pretty much perfect apart from the last corner, where I thought I was in the wall. Everything I wanted to achieve I achieved and it's one of those moments when I was in that flow state."

Hamilton, who had crashed at the final corner in practice and missed the final half of the session, did improve on his last lap, but only by 0.06secs and it was not enough to prevent him falling backwards.

He edged Leclerc by just 0.006secs as Ferrari rued yet another tantalising chance slipping through their fingers.

Norris' performance was put in perspective by Piastri, who was 0.470secs off his team-mate's pace.

Russell, meanwhile, could have done with a morale-boosting performance after he finished second to Antonelli in Monza last weekend when the Italian took a stunning win from 19th on the grid.

The Briton had looked more or less on Antonelli's pace for much of the weekend, even if he clearly lacked the Italian's fluid ability to let the car run free and flow and slide on corner exits.

And in qualifying the difference was a stark 0.314secs, making more likely the prospect of the 66-point gap in the championship between them extending still further on Sunday.

The top 10 was completed by Red Bull's Liam Lawson, Alpine's Franco Colapinto and the Racing Bulls of Arvid Lindblad, the British rookie again impressing.

Local heroes Carlos Sainz and Fernando Alonso were unable to give the Spanish fans much to cheer about as both were knocked out after the first session in 17th and 18th places.

Sainz's Williams edged out Aston Martin's Alonso by just 0.076secs but faces an investigation into impeding Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas that could result in a three-place grid drop.

10. Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) +1.217
authors: Andrew Benson - F1 Correspondent in Madrid
